name: xWin Finance
fix_description: In _swapBNBToTokens, the slippage control uses PancakeLibrary.getReserves to calculate the minimum output (quote), but this value is based on current (manipulable) reserves. Use a TWAP-based price or external oracle for the slippage baseline, not the spot reserves that can be manipulated in the same transaction via flash loan.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is a multi-step flashloan attack that requires understanding protocol-specific reward/referral logic plus token swaps and repeated subscribe/redeem cycling to amplify rewards. While the bug class itself is not deeply obscure, reproducing the full attack needs several contract interactions, looped state manipulation, and AMM reserve-based swap handling.
